name: combobox
purpose: Editable single-select combobox with list autocomplete (WAI-ARIA 1.2). Focus stays on the input; the active option is conveyed with aria-activedescendant. The listbox renders in the top layer and is positioned by the positioning engine.
whenToUse: Choosing one value from a list long enough to benefit from filtering (roughly 7+ options).
Forms that submit a single option value.
whenNotToUse: Fewer than ~7 options: use a radio group or native select.
Free-text entry with suggestions (custom values are not supported).
Multiple selection: use Multi Select (or Checkbox Group for a few options).
responsive: Input is full width of its container; the listbox matches the input width, flips above when space below is insufficient, and caps its height to the available space and the popover-max-height token.
rtl: Logical properties; popup alignment honours the `direction` option/configuration.
theme: Control surface, selected, hover and focus tokens. Active option uses an outline (not color alone). Forced-colors mode uses Highlight/HighlightText.
security: Option labels and descriptions are rendered with textContent. CSP-safe (popover positioning uses the CSSOM).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. A hidden input carries the selected value for form submission when `name` is set.

performance.testedScale: 1,000 options. Larger lists require virtualization, which is not available; use loadOptions instead.

limitations: Strict selection: the value is always one of the options; free text reverts to the selected label on blur.
No virtualization: all filtered options are rendered.
No option groups; one value only (use Multi Select for several).
Filtering is diacritic- and case-insensitive substring or prefix matching; no fuzzy matching.
Result counts are announced through a shared polite live region 400 ms after typing stops.
unsupported: Option values that are not strings.
antiPatterns: Using a combobox for navigation menus.
Auto-selecting the first match on typing (not supported by design).

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/combobox: AuiCombobox directive ([auiCombobox]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/combobox: AuiCombobox component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
